title: Create scene state engine
description:
Create chatbot/rooms/scene.py implementing a scene state engine that tracks location, activity, tone, intensity, and supports pause/resume across sessions.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- chatbot/rooms/room.py (created by task b.1 — understand Room dataclass and scene_id reference)
- chatbot/rooms/__init__.py (created by task b.1)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/rooms/scene.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed path. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed file modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

Implementation details:

1. Create chatbot/rooms/scene.py with:
   - Module docstring: 'Scene state engine for roleplay and contextual rooms. Tracks location, activity, tone, intensity, and supports pause/resume across sessions.'
   - A `SceneState` dataclass with: scene_id (str), room_id (str), location (str), activity (str), tone (Literal['light', 'serious', 'tense', 'playful', 'romantic', 'neutral'], default 'neutral'), intensity (int, 1-10, default 5, clamped in __post_init__), is_paused (bool, default False), started_at (str, isoformat), paused_at (str | None), resumed_at (str | None), participants (list[str], default empty), scene_context (str, default empty — freeform narrative context), metadata (dict[str, Any], default empty).
   - An async function `create_scene(room_id: str, location: str = '', activity: str = '') -> SceneState` that generates a uuid4 scene_id, sets started_at, and persists to the database.
   - An async function `get_scene(scene_id: str) -> SceneState | None` that reads from the database.
   - An async function `update_scene(scene_id: str, **kwargs) -> SceneState` that accepts partial updates: location, activity, tone, intensity, is_paused, scene_context, participants. Updates only the provided fields. Returns updated SceneState. Raises ValueError if scene_id not found.
   - An async function `pause_scene(scene_id: str) -> SceneState` that sets is_paused=True and paused_at=utcnow isoformat.
   - An async function `resume_scene(scene_id: str) -> SceneState` that sets is_paused=False and resumed_at=utcnow isoformat.
   - An async function `end_scene(scene_id: str) -> SceneState` that sets is_paused=False and records ended_at. Ending is terminal — subsequent resume_scene raises ValueError.
   - An async function `get_active_scene(room_id: str) -> SceneState | None` that returns the most recent unpaused, un-ended scene for the room.
   - An async function `get_scene_summary(scene_id: str) -> str` that returns a one-paragraph text summary (location, activity, tone, intensity, participants, duration) suitable for context injection.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/rooms/scene.py exists and defines SceneState dataclass with all specified fields
create_scene generates uuid4 scene_id and persists to database
update_scene accepts partial keyword updates and returns updated SceneState
pause_scene sets is_paused=True and paused_at timestamp
resume_scene sets is_paused=False and resumed_at timestamp
end_scene records ended_at and makes subsequent resume raise ValueError
get_active_scene returns the most recent unpaused un-ended scene
get_scene_summary returns a one-paragraph text summary
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends

allowed: use async SQLAlchemy for database operations
generate text summaries from scene fields
forbidden: introduce new database framework or ORM
call LLM providers from scene functions
add real-time collaboration or WebSocket support
